jobs.title: On-Call Fish Hatchery Specialist (Environmental Scientist)
jobs.description:
Grounded in safety, quality, and ethics, our experts lead their fields with dedication, a creative spirit, and a vision for growth. We draw from more than 20 technical specialties worldwide and are devoted to fostering a community of diverse talents, backgrounds, and expertise. Here, you can apply your passion and collaborate with top environmental professionals on work that’s vital to our clients and the communities they serve.


Join a team that’s naturally committed to the environment.


Your Opportunity


We are seeking experienced on\-call fish hatchery specialist join our Aquatic Sciences team. We have offices throughout California and our staff work on projects across the Western United States. The successful candidate will join our team of aquatic specialists working on a variety of projects including aquatic ecology, water quality, environmental monitoring, and ecological restoration field programs. Successful candidates may also have opportunities for involvement in environmental impact assessments and multidisciplinary projects across various Environmental Services teams.


Your Responsibilities


* Provide technical expertise on fish culture and hatchery operations.
* Provide technical expertise on steelhead, coho salmon, and Chinook salmon biology.
* Complete field programs as a field crew lead.
* Complete daily field reports and contribute to technical reports or other writing assignments.
* Prioritize safety in all tasks.

Capabilities and Credentials


* Applicant must have fish hatchery operation experience.
* Experience with fish hatchery equipment and processes.
* Applicant must have a strong background with steelhead, Coho salmon, and Chinook salmon biology.
* Must have experience in interacting with regulatory agencies including National Marine Fisheries Service and California Department of Fish and Wildlife (CDFW).
* Knowledge of streamside incubators.
* Experience in developing Hatchery Genetic Management Plans.
* Familiarity with biological field methods, such as electrofishing, hook and line sampling, seining, fish identification, redd surveys, stream assessment methods, and the use of tools such as backpack electrofishers, and water quality assessments.
* Experience in working with steelhead and salmon including surveys, capture and handling, tagging, and data analysis.
* Proficient with QAQC, data analysis, and reporting.
* Availability to complete field work in urban, rural and/or in remote and challenging locations.
* Ability to travel and support work inside and outside the state of California.
* Ability to work in a collaborative team environment.
* Strong professional communication and organizational skills.

Education and Experience


* The ideal candidate should have 20 years or more of experience.
* The following are assets but not required: Electrofishing Safety and Principals Course certificate; CDFW Scientific Collection Permit, ESA Section 10a1a permit or 4d authorization.
* Boat operation experience.

Typical office environment working with computers and remaining sedentary for long periods of time. Field work may include exposure to the elements including inclement weather.

jobs.title: HS Science Teacher (Physics & Environmental Science, Long-Term Substitute)
jobs.description:
Description:

We are currently seeking a dynamic and innovative Science/STEM educator to help students embrace science as a tool for understanding the world, pursuing curiosities, and developing critical thinking. This educator will create and develop meaningful, hands\-on explorations of scientific concepts, applying critical reasoning and creativity to real\-world challenges. This full\-time, long\-term substitute position combines teaching high school classes in Physics and Environmental Science.


Requirements:
**Qualifications**:

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited College or University (Master’s degree preferred)
* Teaching credential (preferred but not required)
* Relevant content knowledge, with experience in developing science curriculum and pedagogy
* Commitment to TREE’s educational philosophy and student\-centered approach
* Passion for fostering authentic learning experiences for students
* Dedication to the whole\-person development of young people, including enthusiasm for positive identity development and diversity, equity, and inclusion work
* Experience working with diverse learners, including gifted and neurodiverse students
* Experience in progressive, competency\-based, and experiential education preferred
* Strong communication, organizational, and classroom management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills, including a high degree of cultural competency
* Commitment to anti\-bias practices in the classroom
* Proficient computer skills with Google Workspace and Applications for education

jobs.title: Wildfire Hazard Assessor
jobs.description:
**FLSA**

Non\-exempt

**Department**

Operations

**Pay Type**

Hourly

**Status**

On\-Call/Part\-Time/Full\-Time

**Location**

Office \& Field

**Reports to**

Project Coordinator

**Last Updated**

August 2026

**Company**

Wildfire Services Group, Inc.

**About Wildfire Services**

Wildfire Services Group, Inc. partners with property owners, communities, organizations, and real estate and insurance professionals to deliver actionable Wildfire Intelligence. We assess wildfire risk, develop prioritized risk\-reduction strategies, manage mitigation efforts, and verify measurable results—helping protect properties, strengthen communities, and build long\-term wildfire resilience.

**Role Summary**

The Wildfire Hazard Assessor inspects properties, documents wildfire hazards, and develops clear, prioritized recommendations that help clients reduce ignition potential and improve resilience. The role combines field observation, wildfire science, client education, accurate data collection, and high\-quality reporting from initial assessment through project handoff.

WSG highly values teamwork and collaboration. The Ideal Team Player virtues of Hungry, Humble, and Smart are characteristics that help successful team members thrive and contribute to the company’s growth and development.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct on\-site wildfire hazard assessments for residential, commercial, community, and public properties.
* Evaluate structure vulnerability, defensible space, vegetation conditions, access, topography, weather exposure, and other site\-specific wildfire factors.
* Identify and prioritize vegetation\-management, structure\-hardening, and landscape actions that reduce wildfire hazard.
* Collect complete, accurate field data, photographs, measurements, and geospatial information using WSG\-approved tools and workflows.
* Prepare clear assessment reports that explain findings, priorities, and actionable recommendations in language appropriate for the client.
* Educate property owners, HOAs, community representatives, and partners on wildfire risk, defensible space, and structure hardening.
* Coordinate with GIS, project, and field teams so assessment findings translate into accurate scopes, maps, proposals, and mitigation work.
* Maintain assessment records and data integrity; complete required documentation on time.
* Stay current on applicable wildfire\-resilience practices, standards, regulations, and WSG procedures.
* Represent WSG professionally and provide responsive, practical customer service.

**Qualifications**

* Relevant wildfire, forestry, fire service, natural\-resource, construction, or assessment experience; three years preferred for independent assessor assignments.
* Defensible\-space or wildfire\-assessment certification appropriate to the assigned jurisdiction; NFPA Certified Wildfire Mitigation Specialist (CWMS) or equivalent is preferred.
* Working knowledge of wildfire behavior, defensible space, vegetation management, and structure\-hardening concepts.
* Strong analytical judgment and ability to convert observations and data into prioritized recommendations.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and a strong customer\-service orientation.
* Ability to use mobile data\-collection, mapping, GIS, photography, and reporting tools; training is provided for WSG systems.
* Bachelor’s degree or progress toward a degree in forestry, environmental science, natural\-resource management, fire science, or related field is preferred; equivalent experience may substitute.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with project, GIS, and field teams.

**Physical Demands**

* Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to assessment locations.
* Ability to work outdoors for extended periods, walk or hike over mixed terrain, and lift/carry up to 50 lbs.

**Travel Requirements**

* Regular regional travel is required; occasional extended or overnight travel may be required.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Compensation is competitive and based on experience, qualifications, and role requirements.
* Benefits, reimbursements, allowances, and professional\-development support are provided in accordance with current company policy and eligibility.

**Success Factors**

* Assessment data and reports are complete, accurate, and delivered on time.
* Recommendations are practical, prioritized, and aligned with WSG standards.
* Clients understand the findings and next steps; handoffs to project and field teams are clear.
* Safety, professionalism, and data integrity are consistently maintained.

*This job description describes the general nature and level of work expected. Duties may evolve based on business needs, and reasonable accommodations will be considered as required by applicable law.*

Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Referral program

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Windsor, CA 95492

jobs.title: Program Manager, Privacy Risk Assessment
jobs.description:
Meta's Privacy Risk Assessment team plays a critical role in evaluating privacy risks across a wide range of initiatives, including product launches, partnerships, data integrations, and corporate transactions. In this role, you will lead privacy risk assessments across diverse workstreams, identifying data protection risks, evaluating privacy posture, and partnering with Legal, Policy, Engineering, and cross\-functional teams to drive risk mitigation strategies. You will operate with a high degree of independence, exercising judgment across complex, time\-sensitive initiatives where privacy risk intersects with regulatory compliance, product development, and business strategy.  

  

  

### **Program Manager, Privacy Risk Assessment Responsibilities:**

* Lead end\-to\-end privacy risk assessments across product launches, partnerships, data integrations, and corporate transactions, evaluating data practices, consent frameworks, data retention policies, and regulatory compliance posture
* Identify, document, and communicate privacy risks associated with proposed initiatives, including risks related to data transfers, third\-party sharing, sensitive data categories, and cross\-border data flows
* Develop and maintain structured privacy risk assessment frameworks and playbooks tailored to different initiative types and risk profiles
* Partner with Legal, Policy, Engineering, and Product teams to ensure that privacy risk findings are integrated into decision\-making, product design, and implementation planning
* Advise cross\-functional partners on complex privacy matters, translating regulatory requirements and privacy principles into actionable guidance
* Track and manage privacy risk remediation commitments across active initiatives, ensuring timely follow\-through and appropriate documentation
* Contribute to team\-level goals by helping to define short, mid, and long\-term priorities for the privacy risk assessment program
* Engage leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders to build alignment on privacy risk findings and support informed decision\-making
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations by ensuring that initiatives are evaluated against applicable data protection laws, including GDPR, CCPA, and other global privacy frameworks

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6\+ years of experience in privacy program management, privacy compliance, risk management, or a related field with direct exposure to data protection or regulatory compliance
* Experience conducting privacy risk assessments, compliance reviews, or due diligence across product launches, partnerships, or corporate transactions
* Experience analyzing data practices, data flows, and privacy controls across complex technical environments and translating findings into structured risk assessments
* Experience working cross\-functionally with Legal, Engineering, and Policy stakeholders to drive risk mitigation and decision\-making in ambiguous, time\-sensitive contexts
* Familiarity with global privacy regulations and frameworks, including GDPR, CCPA, or equivalent data protection laws
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience managing privacy risk assessments at a technology company, law firm, or consulting firm across diverse initiative types
* Experience using AI tools or automation to improve risk assessment workflows, documentation quality, or operational efficiency
* Familiarity with privacy\-by\-design principles and experience evaluating privacy controls in consumer\-facing technology products or platforms
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Relevant privacy certifications such as CIPP, CIPM, or CIPT
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  

  

  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
  

  

Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations\-ext@meta.com.  

  

$122,000/year to $180,000/year \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits
